zh.A: 專案按計畫進行，進度符合時程，預計如期交付。
zh.B: 專案進度落後，交付日期延後，無法依原定時程完成。
zh.C: 專案遭遇阻礙，工作卡關，需要先排除問題才能繼續。
zh.D: 專案已取消，不再繼續執行，也不會交付原定成果。

en.A: The project is on track and progressing as planned. Delivery is expected on schedule.
en.B: The project is delayed and behind schedule. Delivery will miss the original deadline.
en.C: The project is blocked by an unresolved dependency. Work cannot proceed until it is resolved.
en.D: The project has been cancelled. Work will not resume and the planned deliverable will not be shipped.

instructions.zh: 依據目前文字，專案現在最符合下列哪一種狀態？判斷規則：以最新的明確狀態陳述為準；條件尚未發生時，判斷目前的狀態；只有本專案被終止才算取消，其他專案或子項目被取消不算；已經排除的阻礙不算卡關；日期以第一行的「今天」為準。
instructions.en: Based on the current text, which project status is best supported? Rules: the latest explicit status statement wins; if a condition has not happened yet, judge the current status; only termination of this project counts as cancelled, not other projects or sub-items; a blocker that has been resolved is not blocked; dates are judged against the "Today" line.

task_S.option_order: fixed A-D except the Q6 order-permutation runs
task_S.nli_note: D2 NLI receives only the rendered state and the option texts; it cannot receive instructions

h_dat_precomputed: each H-dat record also carries state_precomputed (same facts, comparisons stated in parentheses); scored as a separate variant, same gold

q6_paraphrase.sampling: seeded, stratified by hard type over all types except H-lng, test and calibration in proportion
q6_paraphrase.order_permutation: each original and rewrite also asked with options in reversed order D-A (keys keep meaning)

task_P.positives: every twin pair (same pair_id, different gold); old = lower id
task_P.negatives: each Q6 original paired with each of its two rewrites (same gold)
task_P.direct: v2.1 paired question (OLD/NEW layout) for arms that support it

review.author: this Claude Code session and its authoring subagents (protocol §3.4)
review.blind_reviewer: separate Claude subagent with no shared context, a different Claude model tier than the author; sees rendered state + instructions + options only; items shuffled
review.adjudicator: third separate Claude subagent; sees both answers and reasons, not hard_type

J.hardware: Modal L4 for the ladder; tokens from env modal / modal_secret via jevlike scripts/modal.sh
J.readout: first-token letter probabilities via jevlike decide/ (unchanged)

DM_eg2.truncation: flagged when rendered input exceeds 512 tokens

D2_NLI.score: v2 D2 single over the four option texts

C.description: v2 C_same_classification on P only (EG2 float32 label-distribution distance)

metrics.calibration: one temperature per arm fit on calibration split; ECE (10 bins) and Brier on test
metrics.p_thresholds: fixed on calibration split at 0% and 1% FPR; test reports realised FPR

decision_rule.power_note: overall test ~440 detects >= 8 points at ~0.97; 5-8 point gaps that fail are reported as underpowered, not comparable

hypotheses.H12: overall test: J-26B clearly higher than J-E4B; also judged per group
hypotheses.H13: hard type with J-E2B >= 0.95 is too easy; removed from group judgement and group recomputed
hypotheses.H14: DM-GLiNER vs J-26B on G1+G2 combined: upper 95% CI of (26B - GLiNER) < 0.05 -> GLiNER replaces D2 as local single-side judge
hypotheses.H15: H-dat precomputed minus raw for J-26B >= 0.08
hypotheses.H16: GD1 clearly higher than J-26B and Q6 consistency >= 0.9 -> GD1 as reviewer layer
hypotheses.H17: P derived >= P direct, per arm
hypotheses.H18: calibration-split thresholds give realised test FPR <= 2x target
